clips.title: The story
paras: Bluff Runner Windstrider is a wandering tauren messenger roaming the mesas of Thunder Bluff. He carries urgent dispatches across the city, directing Horde adventurers toward distant frontiers like Ashenvale, Feralas, and the Plaguelands.

Thunder Bluff's soaring plateaus require swift feet to keep its leaders and visitors informed, and Bluff Runner Windstrider fills that vital role. Continually jogging the rope bridges and pathways of the tauren capital, he acts as a town crier and dispatch runner. When key outposts across Kalimdor or the Eastern Kingdoms require reinforcements, Windstrider flags down passing champions to carry word and take up the call to arms.

Windstrider's dispatches range far beyond Mulgore's serene borders. He directs adventurers northward into Ashenvale to join Senani Thunderheart's great hunt at Splintertree Post, points hardened scouts south toward Camp Mojache in deep Feralas, and relays grave warnings regarding the ongoing undead menace in the Western Plaguelands. Through him, the tribal heart of Mulgore stays bound to the wider conflicts of the Horde.
